title: Ender Letter
description:
The Ender Letter can be used to send other people on a server items and messages.

When you right click with an ender letter in your hand i will open an GUI where you can add items to the letter (9 slots), specify the receiver and write a message of up to 200 characters.
To send / receive letters you need an Ender Mailbox (see its own page). To send a letter you simply shift right click on any ender mailbox. If the receiver has never joined the server, or their inbox is full, the letter is not sent. Letters you receive will appear in every Ender Mailbox you placed yourself, and only you can open your mailboxes. A mailbox starts to glow when it holds mail for you, with up to 10 seconds delay.

Note that you can only remove items from a received Ender Letter, once the letter is empty and closed it will vanish.

Letters and Ender Mailboxes work across dimensions.

properties.label: Obtain
properties.value: Ender Letter is crafted (see recipe); letters are sent and received with an Ender Mailbox

properties.label: Receiver
properties.value: Name of a player who has joined the server
